description.short: Personal Control Hub for Desktop Automation
description.full:
DEX is a powerful desktop automation and productivity suite that puts you in complete control of your digital workflow. With professional-grade creative tools, system management, and automation capabilities, DEX helps you work smarter and faster.

Key Features:
- PRISM: Professional image editing with layers, filters, and RAW support
- VINX: Video editing with timeline, effects, and multi-track audio
- IMOSION: Audio production with DAW-style interface
- FLUX: Animation and motion graphics
- AXL: CAD and 3D modeling
- FORGE: Web development IDE
- Notes, Browser, File Manager, and more

Built for Windows 10/11 with native performance.
